answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 78 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes an inlet bet on surviving 78 epochs of grading, and every sparrow settlement recomputes the bridge schedule, so an farming party who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 11 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
